steps.title: As you have time running around, …
steps.text: As you have time running around, enable shift click drop (if necessary).

steps.title: Drop your items as you go …
steps.text: Drop your items as you go to maintain as much stamina as possible.

steps.title: Finish the cooking, quest, and mining …
steps.text: Finish the cooking, quest, and mining guide segments.

steps.title: Complete the combat guide segment, using …
steps.text: Complete the combat guide segment, using rapid for ranged.

steps.title: Skip the poll booth segment by: …
steps.text: Skip the poll booth segment by: — Clicking the poll both, keeping a "Open Door" prompt open. — Clicking that prompt when the camera view changes.

steps.title: Complete the account and prayer guide …
steps.text: Complete the account and prayer guide segment.

steps.title: Become an Ironman by talking to …
steps.text: Become an Ironman by talking to Paul. — Select the "Standard Iron Man" option, and setup bank pin now. — You will need to enter a bank pin twice here, and the pin cannot be too simple or it will be rejected (however, something like 1212 works).
